params.body:
## What

A proposal, no code: `docs/journal-voorstel.md` (Dutch, like the other docs in this repo) describes adding a journal (blog) to hoet.be with its content in the shared Sanity Studio.

It covers:

- **What works for search and answer engines** (Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot), measured against what hoet.be already has: server-rendered HTML, canonical/hreflang, `Organization`/`WebSite`/`BreadcrumbList`, a sitemap with honest `lastmod`. What we deliberately skip: `llms.txt`, FAQPage/HowTo for rich results, meta keywords, unreviewed generated articles.
- **Information architecture**: `/{locale}/journal`, five fixed categories, a controlled tag list (tag pages `noindex` under five articles), and references from articles to frames and collections so internal links come from data.
- **Content guidelines**: tone, article types and lengths, structure (answer first), metadata limits, `BlogPosting` JSON-LD, and a strict no-fallback rule per language so an untranslated article never appears under another language's URL.
- **Publishing workflow**: draft, signed preview route, review, publish via the existing webhook, scheduling through `publishedAt` (no paid Sanity plan), 410 for withdrawn articles.
- **Implementation plan**: new Sanity types (`journalPost`, `journalCategory`, `journalTag`, shared `author`, `localeRichBlock`, `seo`), all additive so Cabrio and hoet-design.com are untouched; Laravel routes above the `/{slug}` catch-all, `JournalController`, PortableText additions, optional `$alternates`/`$ogType` in the SEO partial, sitemap and RSS; UI built from existing theme markup.
- **Roadmap** in six phases with estimates, a **risk table**, and four open decisions (name, launch languages, who writes, AI training crawlers).

## Test notes

- Documentation only; no PHP, Blade, route or config file changes, so the existing suite and CI (Pint, PHPStan, PHPUnit) are unaffected.
- The proposal's claims about the current code were checked against `main` (`seo.blade.php`, `breadcrumbs.blade.php`, `SitemapController`, `SanitySync::MIRRORED`, route order in `routes/web.php`, the existing feature tests it plans to extend) and against the live site (`robots.txt`, sitemap, no `llms.txt`).
- Section 7.2 holds the test plan for the build itself: 15 feature tests (scheduling, no language fallback, hreflang, schema, sitemap, feed, preview signing, route order, heading hierarchy) plus vitest invariants on the Studio side in 7.1.
- Merging this changes nothing on the site; the decisions in section 10 come first.
params.title: Proposal: a Sanity-backed journal for hoet.be
